# KubeRocketCI

> KubeRocketCI is an open-source, Kubernetes-native software delivery platform. It provides one golden path for developers and AI agent fleets: opinionated Tekton pipelines, quality gates, RBAC guardrails, GitOps audit trails, and ephemeral environments that spin up per hypothesis and tear down clean.

KubeRocketCI positions itself as the harness for AI fabrics — the delivery infrastructure that fleets of AI coding agents need to ship software safely at machine speed. Pipelines and quality gates did not vanish in the agentic era; they became its control point.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kuberocketci.io/): Platform overview — benefits, features, and why agent fleets need a delivery harness
- [AI Factory](https://kuberocketci.io/ai-factory): Why the delivery layer became the control point of the AI factory, and how KubeRocketCI provides the execution harness, quality gates, guardrails, audit trail, ephemeral environments, and fleet observability
- [Use Cases](https://kuberocketci.io/use-cases): Practical scenarios — application scaffolding, autotest quality gates, secrets management, custom Tekton pipelines, feature-branch deployments
- [Pricing](https://kuberocketci.io/pricing): Open-source core plus professional service subscription tiers
